a: Specificity ranks which CSS rule wins when selectors conflict.
Cascade combines origin, importance, specificity, and order.
flex-grow controls how extra space is distributed among items.
transform moves, scales, rotates elements without reflowing layout the same way.
transition animates property changes over time.
@keyframes defines steps of a CSS animation.
prefers-color-scheme media query detects dark mode preference.
Container queries style based on parent size, not only viewport.
clamp(min, preferred, max) sets a responsive value with bounds.
